summary: Iteration 11 verification — 15/15 backend pytest tests PASS and 5/5 targeted frontend UI checks PASS. Backend deltas verified: (a) /site/payment-provider default -> {provider: cashfree, cashfree_active: false, mock_mode: true}. (b) /payments/easebuzz/{initiate,verify} both return 404 (removed). (c) /admin/payment-config GET strips any easebuzz_* keys, exposes cashfree_secret_masked ending in the real 4 chars; POST with `provider: razorpay` is ignored — server hard-forces provider=cashfree in response. (d) Cashfree MOCK: POST /payments/cashfree/initiate returns {mock:true, payment_session_id:'mock_...'} when cashfree_active=false; POST /payments/cashfree/verify marks order paid, decrements stock, and triggers process_paid_joining (new user became is_joining_paid=true after buying hamper). (e) Multi-account OTP verify at phone 9876500099 returns {multiple:true, accounts:[..]} with EG000043 + EG000044 each carrying `username` field. (f) /auth/otp/pick-account returns token which authenticates /users/dashboard. (g) /auth/forgot-password/lookup returns single:false + 2 accounts (each with username). (h) /auth/forgot-password without user_code returns {multiple:true, accounts:[..]}; with user_code=EG000043 + new_password='NewPass@123' resets only that account — EG000043 logs in with new pw AND EG000044 still logs in with its original Test@123. (i) Single-account phone auto-login: newly registered phone with 1 account returns {token,user} (no multiple flag). (j) /orders/create returns order with payment_provider=null and NO razorpay_mock/razorpay_order_id keys. Frontend deltas verified on preview URL: JoinNow /join-now — Send OTP reveals join-otp-input + join-dev-otp banner (Firebase reCAPTCHA no longer hijacks step 2). Login /login OTP tab (selectors: otp-phone-input, send-otp-btn, otp-code-input, verify-otp-btn) — phone 9876500099 → OTP → multi-account-picker renders with pick-account-EG000043 + pick-account-EG000044; @username strings visible; clicking a card logs into /dashboard as Test One (EG000043). Forgot-password link on /login (forgot-password-link) navigates to /forgot-password. /forgot-password full flow (fp-phone-input → fp-send-otp-btn → fp-otp-input → fp-verify-otp-btn → fp-account-picker with fp-pick-EG000043 → fp-new-password + fp-confirm-password → fp-submit-btn) succeeds and redirects to /login. /admin/payments shows admin-payments-page, prominent MOCK MODE banner, Cashfree-only card with cf-app-id-input, cf-secret-input (secret masked), cf-env-sandbox, cf-env-prod, cf-active-toggle, pg-save-btn; NO 'easebuzz' string anywhere in the DOM.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2140 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth, mlm, payments, admin, site) before more features land.

/admin/payment-config POST silently ignores non-whitelisted keys (good), but the response `config` still includes cashfree_secret_key when the caller sent one. The GET path masks it, but the POST echo leaks the plaintext secret back to the browser (line 1306). Consider stripping any key containing 'secret' from the response payload.

/payments/cashfree/verify uses `payment_mock` flag stored on the order to auto-succeed. A client could theoretically send /verify without first calling /initiate — the flag would be missing and it would fall through to real Cashfree verify. In mock deployments this returns 500. Safer: re-check is_live from settings inside /verify and short-circuit.
/auth/otp/pick-account does not check OTP expiry (only checks verified flag). If a user picks 30 min after verify, still succeeds. Consider re-checking expires_at.

/auth/forgot-password does not consume the OTP (no $unset of verified/otp), so the same OTP could be reused to reset a second account or replay. Consider invalidating the OTP row after successful reset.
Register endpoint enforces terms_accepted (good) but /auth/register model field is `terms_accepted`, not the more conventional `accept_terms` — worth documenting for client integrations.
